every moment. In joy, we
celebrate marriages. In sorrow, we honor
our dead. On the Sabbath, we gather as
one. Families rejoicing together, bound
by the commandments of God. Yet are we
tried.
From the stones in Kenya to the hatred
in Montana, we endure as a soldier of
the Lord.
And still the mission expands on the
airwaves, on the screens, in every
nation under heaven. Israel's voice is
heard.
We build our communities. We raise our
children in royalty.
>> We restore what was broken. We clean
what was defiled.
We show the world who we are.
This is Israel united in Christ. Nation
in motion. Nation endures.
